answer: Bind each identity to a distinct, aged domain it alone controls, proven by a DNS record the network re-checks every epoch. A domain is a scarce, costly vault: public registration history, yearly renewal fees, and a visible age on the horizon of the DNS. One operator cannot mint a thousand credible identities without buying and aging a thousand domains, and a relic of genuine history — years of renewals — is trust no sockpuppet farm can fake cheaply.
